deck.name: ASL Alphabet
deck.description: American Sign Language fingerspelling — all 26 letters of the alphabet.

cards.label: A
cards.desc: Closed fist with thumb resting on the side — like gripping a small ball.

cards.label: B
cards.desc: Four fingers straight up together, thumb folded across the palm.

cards.label: C
cards.desc: Curved hand forming a C shape — fingers and thumb gently bent.

cards.label: D
cards.desc: Index finger points up, remaining fingers touch the thumb tip.

cards.label: E
cards.desc: Fingers bent downward touching the thumb — like a claw.

cards.label: F
cards.desc: Index finger and thumb form a circle; other three fingers extended upward.

cards.label: G
cards.desc: Index finger points sideways, thumb parallel — like pointing a gun to the side.

cards.label: H
cards.desc: Index and middle fingers extended together, pointing sideways.

cards.label: I
cards.desc: Pinky finger extended upward, all other fingers curled into a fist.

cards.label: J
cards.desc: Start with pinky up (like I), then trace a J arc downward in the air.

cards.label: K
cards.desc: Index and middle fingers form a V, with thumb tucked between them.

cards.label: L
cards.desc: Index finger points up, thumb extends outward — a classic L shape.

cards.label: M
cards.desc: Three fingers folded over a tucked thumb.

cards.label: N
cards.desc: Two fingers folded over a tucked thumb.

cards.label: O
cards.desc: All fingers curve to meet the thumb — forming a clear O shape.

cards.label: P
cards.desc: Like K but rotated — hand points downward.

cards.label: Q
cards.desc: Like G but rotated — hand points downward.

cards.label: R
cards.desc: Index and middle fingers crossed over each other.

cards.label: S
cards.desc: Fist with thumb resting across the curled fingers — a strong grip.

cards.label: T
cards.desc: Thumb tucked between the index and middle fingers.

cards.label: U
cards.desc: Index and middle fingers extended together, pointing straight up.

cards.label: V
cards.desc: Index and middle fingers spread apart — the classic peace/victory sign.

cards.label: W
cards.desc: Index, middle, and ring fingers spread and pointing up — three prongs.

cards.label: X
cards.desc: Index finger bent into a hook shape.

cards.label: Y
cards.desc: Thumb and pinky extended outward — the shaka / hang-loose shape.

cards.label: Z
cards.desc: Index finger traces a Z shape in the air.
